newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Probanka sees its 96 net profit up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Probanka sees its 96 net profit up 10 pct.

text.p: Slovenian bank Probanka said on Monday it expects 1996 net profit to increase by 10 percent to some 400 million tolars ($2.8 million).
"Our profit and balance sheet assets were up mostly due to the increased business in our existing business units," Romana Pajenk, general manager of Probanka told Reuters.
The bank's balance sheet assets in 1996 rose by about 30 percent from 18 billion tolars in 1995.
"With some fresh marketing moves we managed to increase our businesses which we will continue to do also in the future," Pajenk said.
She said the bank expected to increase its balance sheet by another 20 percent and its profit by 10 percent in 1997.
The Economist magazine has ranked Probanka as the fifth among Slovenia's 28 registered banks.
Shares in Probanka, which is listed on the Ljubljana Stock Exchange, rose 1.20 percent to 16,800 tolars in early Monday trade on volume of 41 shares.
